old_caption: The video captures a woman performing a belly dance in a well-lit studio. She is dressed in an elegant black dress adorned with gold embellishments around the waist and hemline. Her long, dark hair flows freely as she moves gracefully across the floor. The studio features a large mirror on one wall, reflecting her movements and adding depth to the scene. The lighting is bright, highlighting her fluid motions and the intricate details of her costume. As she dances, she transitions through various poses, her arms and hands moving expressively, while her hips sway rhythmically. The background remains consistent throughout the video, focusing entirely on her performance. The camera remains stationary, capturing the full body of the dancer and allowing viewers to appreciate the elegance and precision of her movements.

caption: The video captures a woman dancing in a studio, seen from behind in the foreground with her reflection in a wall-sized mirror to the right, in a black top, gold coin belt, and flowing black skirt trimmed in gold. She holds a near-static pose with one hand on her hip and the other arm extended to the side. That hand then leaves her waist as an arm swings outward and the other drops, her head tilting toward the mirror while a hand rises to her neck. A hair whip follows, her long dark hair flinging out before arcing back as her head tilts up and back. The hair settles while she holds the tilted posture, a hand at her chest. She continues a slow torso rotation, the skirt and hair swaying side to side. An arm extends outward again toward the end. The mirror reproduces each change against a fixed background.
